invariant: DanglingSymlinkSafety: Any path approved by assertInsideProject/resolveInsideProject must have its true physical canonical target (including any symlink target, whether existing or dangling) contained within the project root
preconditions: Workspace contains a symlink whose target does not yet exist and points outside the project root
sequence: 1. Attacker or agent creates symlink link_dir -> /tmp/outside_target; 2. Tool calls assertInsideProject(root, 'link_dir/file.txt'); 3. realpath throws ENOENT; 4. canonicalize wrongly treats link_dir as missing regular file and resolves parent (project root); 5. Validation succeeds; 6. Tool writes/reads through symlink, escaping project root
alloy_verdict: COUNTEREXAMPLE on mutant (SAT) / VERIFIED on hardened (UNSAT)
observed: assertInsideProject resolved successfully to project/dangling_link.txt, allowing path escape
patch: In canonicalize(), when fs.realpath throws ENOENT/ENOTDIR, check fs.lstat(current).isSymbolicLink(); if so, readlink and redirect current to resolved link target instead of stripping to parent, bounded by max 40 hops (ELOOP)

invariant: ProcessWorkingDirContainment: Subprocess execution cwd must never escape project root or allowed platform temp directory across all sandbox modes
preconditions: Caller provides RunOptions with cwd outside project root
sequence: 1. Subprocess spawned with options.cwd = /etc or /Users/...; 2. bwrapArgs normalizes cwd to project root, but runProcess directly passed options.cwd to Node spawn for sandbox-exec and none modes; 3. Child process runs with cwd pointing outside project workspace
expected: spawnCwd falls back to project root if outside project and tempdir
observed: spawnCwd passed raw options.cwd directly to child process
patch: In runProcess, compute effectiveCwd = isInside(project, rawCwd) || isInside(platformTmp, rawCwd) ? rawCwd : project, and pass effectiveCwd as spawnCwd when wrapped.mode !== 'bwrap'
post_fix_evidence: Vitest packages/tools passes (107 passed, 10 skipped across 19 files); typecheck passes
limitations: Applies to sandbox-exec and host (none) execution modes
